On a grey Tuesday he found a green bottle wedged between the rocks below the gallery stairs. The cork had swollen tight. Inside lay one sheet of paper, folded small, written in pencil. It said: 'If you read this, the light is still burning. Please tell my father I reached the shore.' There was no name and no date. Tomas sat on the cold step for a long while, turning the paper over in his hands. That night he lit the lamp early, and for the first time he whispered thanks to the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在湿漉漉的街面上投下昏黄的光，红绿灯仍旧固执地变换颜色，却没有一辆车等待。早点铺的老板刚拉开卷帘门，蒸笼里升起第一缕白气。清洁工的扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗亮着，像未眠的眼睛。风从河面吹来，带着一点凉意和潮湿的味道。再过一会儿，天边就会泛白，这座城市又将醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll, and you keep opening until you reach the tiny one that does not open.\n- That tiny doll is the stopping point, and without it the opening would never end."}
